sonido/4227938:
Two field-reported bugs from the live demo:

1. CRASH ON LOAD (panic kills the whole app). ThemeLayout::split_vertical did
   panel_content_h.clamp(panel_min_h=120, content_h*ratio); when the web canvas
   inits at a tiny height the cap drops below the min, so clamp(120, 0.5) panics
   ('min > max'). Floor the cap at panel_min_h so the clamp args are always valid;
   at a degenerate height both dims take their minimums and the layout overflows
   gracefully instead of crashing. Regression test added.

2. REVERB FEEDBACK BLOW-UP + 'audio won't restart'. A high-feedback reverb fed a
   sustained tone can drive a feedback buffer to Inf/NaN, which then poisons every
   later block forever (the poison lives in the effect's delay line, so stop/play
   never recovers). Engine-level safety net in the audio callback: if the wet
   block goes non-finite, flush the whole graph state and silence that block so the
   next starts clean; per-sample, flush non-finite output to silence and hard-cap
   at ~+12 dBFS so a blow-up can't blast the speakers. Transparent to normal audio
   (|x| <= 1); covers every effect regardless of internals.

Verified: native + wasm clean under stable 1.96 -D warnings; clippy + 56 tests
green; no panic at a 360x300 window (would have crashed pre-fix).
